# Build the defense  prime for the  Global South

Terra designs and manufactures the autonomous systems that protect critical infrastructure across Africa and the Global South. We hire engineers, operators and builders to take that work further.

## Life at Terra

Factory floors in Abuja, deployments on mine sites, and the teams who put the systems in the field.

![Terra Industries drone factory building](https://www.terraindustries.co/_next/image?url=%2Ffigma%2Fnews-factory.webp&w=3840&q=75&dpl=dpl_63JAWaV8ELggcMfDtAm1FLgBrYCQ)
